claim: Resetting the communication channel more than once does not yield additional performance improvements in multi-agent collaboration.
falsifier: In a multi-agent system with communication channel resets as intervention, compare performance after one reset versus two or more resets to determine if additional resets provide further gains.

conditions: in the context of monitoring and intervention mechanisms
exclusions: limited to the sampled environments and models; may not hold for other task complexities or intervention types

title: Number of communication channel–performance improvement boundary
